questions.stem: All are features of lead poisoning, EXCEPT:
questions.solutionHtml:
Diarrhea

Features of lead poisoning are:-

  1. Facial pallor
  2. Anemia
  3. Lead line
  4. Lead palsy
  5. Encephalopathy
  6. Cardiovascular System and Kidneys: Lead causes vascular constriction, leading to hypertension and permanent arteriolar degeneration. Chronic arteriosclerotic nephritis and interstitial nephritis occur.
  7. Reproductive System: Menstrual derangements, such as amenorrhoea, dysmenorrhoea, menorrhagia, sterility of both sexes and abortion are frequent. Abortion occurs in pregnant women between 3 to 6 months.
  8. Other Systems: They are dyspepsia, anorexia, emaciation, general weakness, exhaustion, irritability, foul breath, headache, vertigo, loss of hair, and drowsiness. Peripheral neuritis is rare.




KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 34th Edition, Page Number 53 & 35th Edition, Page Number: 40

questions.stem: Amyl nitrate is used as an antidote for which poisoning?
questions.solutionHtml:
Hydro cyanide poisoning

Hydrocyanic poisoning treatment:- Break 0.2 ml. ampoule of amyl nitrite in a handkerchief and hold it over the patient's nose for 15 to 30 seconds every minute, until sodium nitrite infusion is started.




KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 34th Edition, Page Number: 40 & 35th Edition, Page Number: 33
